input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer, so it sits at our preferred position. Clause 12.3 expressly confirms Customer is free to engage any supplier and has made no exclusivity or minimum-volume commitment, and clause 2.1 confirms there is no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining to place further Order Forms is not a breach. Clause 12.4 restricts Vendor from marketing a competing service — that is exclusivity running in Customer's favour and is acceptable, not a deviation. Clause 11's reference to a replacement supplier is likewise consistent with our freedom to source elsewhere. No redline required.
